meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: free (free tier) / not-stated-permanent (permanence not stated on the official site) / trial (trial). status values correspond to group: active (free tier) / not-stated-permanent / trial. cardRequired null means the official page does not state it, false means the official page states no credit card is required. overageBehavior is the overage behavior stated on the official page; unstated cases read “Check the official page”. paidFrom is the paid starting price stated on the official site. limitKind values: daily-monthly (daily plus monthly limits) / daily (metered daily) / monthly (metered monthly). planKind has the same meaning as group. sendgridOveragePdf and sendgridOverageWeb are used only for the SendGrid entry, recording the overage rates shown in the official pricing PDF and on the pricing web page respectively; the two values differ and are recorded side by side.

offers.title: Resend free tier
offers.specText: $0/month: 3,000 emails/month, 100 emails/day, 3 domains, 3 inboxes, 30-day data retention, 5 AI credits, 10,000 automation runs, SSO, ticket support
offers.durationText: The FAQ states a free-forever plan is provided
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official page — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: 3,000 emails/month; 100 emails/day; 3 domains; 3 inboxes; 30-day data retention
offers.overageBehavior: Pay-as-you-go is only available on paid plans; without it, exceeding the limit triggers a notification, with an option to upgrade
offers.paidFrom: Pro $20/month for 50,000 emails; Scale $90/month for 100,000 emails; overage $0.90/1,000 emails
risks: Daily limit of 100 emails and monthly limit of 3,000 emails both apply
Received emails count toward the transactional quota
Up to 3 domains and 3 inboxes
Data retention 30 days
offers.notes: Received emails count toward the transactional quota; Broadcast emails do not count toward the transactional limit.

offers.title: Mailgun free plan
offers.specText: $0/month: 100 emails/day, 1 custom sending domain, RESTful API + SMTP, 1 API key, 1-day log retention, 1 inbound route, 1 user, ticket support
offers.durationText: Not stated as permanent on the official site (page wording: "Test us out"; no "forever" wording anywhere on the page)
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official page — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: 100 emails/day; 1 custom sending domain; 1 API key; 1-day log retention; 1 inbound route; 1 user
offers.paidFrom: Basic from $15/month for 10,000 emails/month; Foundation $35/month for 50,000 emails (first month free); Scale $90/month for 100,000 emails (first month free)
risks: Not stated as permanent on the official site
Sending volume is metered daily, with a daily cap of 100 emails
Log retention 1 day
Free plan limited to 1 user
offers.notes: The FAQ states the free plan is for exploring the platform, with a daily sending limit.

offers.title: Brevo free plan
offers.specText: 300 emails sent per day; up to 100,000 contacts; 1 user; transactional email retry queue 1,000; automation 2,000 contacts; 50 open deals / 1 pipeline
offers.cardNote: Official help center states no card is required; pricing page states "Free forever, no credit card needed."
offers.limitsText: 300 emails sent per day, reset daily, no rollover; up to 100,000 contacts; 1 user; emails always carry the Sent with Brevo branding
offers.paidFrom: Starter from $9/month, Standard from $18/month, Professional from $499/month, Enterprise custom pricing; prices exclude tax; annual billing at 9 tenths of the monthly price
risks: 300 emails per day, reset daily, no rollover
Emails always carry the Sent with Brevo branding
1 user
Paid prices exclude tax
offers.sourceName: Brevo official pricing page and official help center free plan page
offers.notes: The pricing page text capture does not render the daily sending count or prices; the official help center applies.

offers.title: SendGrid trial
offers.specText: Free Trial $0: 60 days, 100 emails/day; 1 teammate, 1 event webhook, 3 days of searchable email activity history
offers.cardNote: Pricing page states "no credit card required, no commitment".
offers.limitsText: 100 emails/day; 1 teammate; 1 event webhook; 3 days of searchable email activity history
offers.overageBehavior: overage charges may apply (overage may be charged; see the plan details for specifics)
offers.paidFrom: Essentials from $19.95/month; Pro from $89.95/month; Premier custom pricing
risks: Only a 60-day trial, no permanent free plan
Trial: 100 emails/day, 3 days of searchable email activity history
Overage may be charged; the PDF and web overage rates differ in value
The old permanent free plan was retired in March–May 2025 (months 3–5; multiple second-hand sources agree)
offers.sourceName: Twilio official SendGrid pricing page and official pricing PDF
offers.notes: The free plan wording on the page refers to the same 60-day trial; the retirement timing of the old permanent free plan comes from multiple second-hand sources that agree.

offers.title: Postmark Free Developer
